items.exampleEn: The two plans are only superficially similar.
items.exampleZh: 這兩個計畫只是表面上相似而已。

items.exampleEn: Please do not leave your bags on unoccupied seats.
items.exampleZh: 請不要把包包放在空著的座位上。

items.exampleEn: She led a quiet, uneventful life in a small village.
items.exampleZh: 她在一個小村子裡過著安靜、平淡無事的生活。

items.exampleEn: My thick hair becomes unmanageable in wet weather.
items.exampleZh: 天氣潮濕時，我濃密的頭髮就變得很難整理。

items.exampleEn: She prefers a spartan office with nothing on the walls.
items.exampleZh: 她偏好牆上什麼都不掛的簡樸辦公室。

items.exampleEn: The family became fabulously rich from selling tea.
items.exampleZh: 這個家族靠賣茶變得極為富有。

items.exampleEn: The young swimmer is phenomenally talented.
items.exampleZh: 這位年輕的游泳選手天分高得驚人。

items.exampleEn: The website changes dynamically as you type.
items.exampleZh: 網站會隨著你打字即時變動。

items.sentenceEn: Traffic in the city center becomes almost unmanageable during the holidays.
items.sentenceZh: 假期期間，市中心的交通幾乎變得難以控制。

items.audioEn: The trip home was uneventful; the train left on time and arrived ten minutes early.
items.audioZh: 回家的旅程平靜無事；火車準時出發，還提早十分鐘到站。
options: The train was delayed for two hours.
They had to change trains twice.

items.sentenceEn: The hotel was fabulously expensive, but the service was perfect.
items.sentenceZh: 這家飯店貴得驚人，但服務無可挑剔。

items.sentenceEn: Most of the offices on this floor are still unoccupied.
items.sentenceZh: 這層樓大部分的辦公室還空著。

items.stemEn: Sales of the new phone grew ____, reaching ten million in a single month.
items.stemZh: 新手機的銷量成長得驚人，單月就達到一千萬支。

items.stemEn: We only looked at the problem ____, so we missed its real cause.
items.stemZh: 我們只從表面看這個問題，所以沒發現真正的原因。

items.passageEn: Last summer, Paul rented a cabin in the mountains to finish his novel. The place was spartan, with just a bed, a desk and a small stove, and the cabins on either side were unoccupied. Superficially, it seemed like the perfect place to write. The views were fabulously beautiful, and the first two weeks were pleasantly uneventful. However, the right ending remained elusive, and without internet, his work emails piled up until they became unmanageable. He drove into town once a week to answer them. The effort paid off: the novel sold phenomenally well, and critics praised the way it moved dynamically between past and present.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，Paul 在山上租了一間小屋，要把小說寫完。那裡很簡樸，只有一張床、一張書桌和一個小爐子，兩旁的小屋也都沒人住。表面上看來，這是個寫作的完美地點。風景美得不得了，頭兩個星期也平靜無事，過得很愉快。然而，理想的結局一直寫不出來；又因為沒有網路，他的工作信件越積越多，多到難以處理。他每星期開車進城一次回信。努力終究有了回報：小說賣得非常好，評論家也稱讚這本書在過去與現在之間生動地切換。

questions.questionZh: Paul 為什麼每星期開車進城一次？
options: 去買食物和爐子用的燃料
跟出版社的人見面討論結局
去參加當地的寫作課程

questions.questionZh: 評論家稱讚這本小說什麼？
options: 把山上的風景寫得非常詳細又美麗
用很簡單的文字講一個複雜的愛情故事
在過去與現在之間生動地切換

items.promptZh: 這家旅館的房間很簡樸，但是很乾淨。
referenceEn: The rooms in this hotel are spartan but clean.
This hotel has spartan but clean rooms.
rubricZh: 「簡樸的」用 spartan，可放 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 spartan but clean rooms）

items.instructionZh: 用 dynamically 造一個句子，描述某個人做事充滿活力，或某件事不斷變化的樣子。
referenceEn: Our teacher teaches so dynamically that no one falls asleep in class.
I like coaches who lead their teams dynamically.
rubricZh: dynamically 是副詞，修飾動詞（例如 teaches dynamically、lead…dynamically 等）
可指「充滿活力地」，也可指「動態地、不斷變化地」
時態配合內容（例如 teaches、like、taught）
